Mobile.dc.html.title: Phone: same flow with the running-total bar

title.text: One site, one look: home → book → pay → booked

how.text:
Press Play on either frame and click through as a customer.

Desktop: your rental stays pinned on the right. Phone: a bar at the bottom shows what you've added and the running total; tap View for the full list.

Real prices from Supabase: 3-day bases $325/$375/$425, prepaid weight $79/ton (vs $99 after), mattress/tire $35, appliance $45.

Morning slot counts are sample numbers. Thu Dec 3 and Mon Dec 7 show a full morning so you can see the grayed-out state.

[PRICE] / [TIME] = not set yet. Payment is a placeholder.
